title: Menu management
description: Maintain the menu hierarchy and route paths: directories group the levels, menus are the page destinations, and actions carry permission keys
containerDescription: Contents of this directory. You can nest more directories or add menus.

empty.title: No menu data

rowActions.comingSoon: This menu will be available in a later release

detail.editGroupDescription: Change the directory's name, route path, icon, sort order and visibility.
detail.deleteGroupConfirm: This action cannot be undone. The directory {{name}} will be permanently deleted.
